title: Coalesce parser text insertions and flush via DOM's replace data
body: Buffer contiguous character insertions in the HTML parser's `pending text` tuple `(insertion location, data)` and flush via DOM's *replace data* when appending to an existing preceding `Text` node (running the parent's *children changed steps* and queueing a `"characterData"` `MutationRecord`). This reflects current interoperable reality. `pending text` is flushed: - in the *tree construction dispatcher* when a non-character token is emitted from the tokenizer; - at the end of the networking task queue tasks that process input byte chunks when loading HTML and plain-text documents; - at the start of *insert a foreign element* (e.g., when a non-whitespace character token triggers implicit `` creation or active formatting element reconstruction); - in *insert a character* when the adjusted insertion location changes; - in *"in table text"*'s *"Anything else"* branch before switching back to the original insertion mode and reprocessing the token; - in *abort a parser*; - at the end of *run a fragment parser*; and - at the end of the *document write steps*. Tests: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/64800. Fixes #12744. --- - [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * Chromium (already implements matching behavior) * Gecko (already implements matching behavior) * WebKit (already implements matching behavior) - [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/64800 - [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chromium: already matches for document parsing; streaming HTML edge cases tracked in https://issues.chromium.org/issues/581018331. Slight mismatch in https://issues.chromium.org/issues/581920330. * Gecko: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2089766 for slight mismatch; streaming HTML tracked in https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2043150 * WebKit: https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=330912 - [x] Corresponding [HTML AAM](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/) & [ARIA in HTML](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/) issues & PRs: N/A - [x] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: N/A - [x] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use.
